About 

Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Learn more about who we are, how you can contact us and how we process personal data in our Privacy Policy.

Company

The medium-sized company OEDIV Oetker Daten- und Informationsverarbeitung KG is part of the Oetker Group and was one of the first SAP customers in the 1970s. 

About OEDIV 
We are a premium provider of infrastructure solutions and managed services for Germany’s SMB sector and global companies. Since 30 years, our mission has been to support and advise customers in all IT matters with great technical expertise and flexibility. We offer you horizontal, flexible and scalable solutions based on established standards. 

Show larger version

Marcus Leeb, Dr Philipp Zielke, Jasmin Schröer 

OEDIV is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Dr. August Oetker KG and so a member of the Oetker Group, which has almost 350 companies and is one of the major family-owned businesses in Germany. We protect your sensitive data in two state-of-the-art data centres boasting a highly available, secure and scalable infrastructure. By also using global data centre capacities and cloud services like Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud, we ensure delivery of our services without boundaries, coupled with protection in compliance with European and German law. 
We aim to be your long-term partner in a holistic, reliable relationship and nurture that through permanent contact persons and comprehensive care and support. We have gained important certification acknowledging our high standards of quality and security, in particular for the further training we offer our employees. We pursue clear strategies and concepts and enable you to benefit from flexible, customised contractual arrangements. 

Key data on the company 
Founded: 1995 
Locations: Bielefeld (headquarters), Oldenburg, Augsburg and Rostock 
Executive management: Jasmin Schröer, Dr. Philipp Zielke, Marcus Leeb 
Headcount: >400 
Number of external customers: >400 
Special features: Own data centres in Europe and global partner locations 
Most important certification: ISO/IEC 27001:2017, ISAE 3402 Type 2 report, TÜV Rheinland: Secure Data Centre, various SAP and Microsoft certification, Microsoft Cloud Service Provider, Citrix Cloud Service Provider
